title: She sold her tech company to a Fortune 200 firm. Then she built a foundation named after her mother.
sources: TriCity Voice - Global nonprofit founder started as Fremont business owner
caption:
She sold her tech company to a Fortune 200 firm. Then she built a foundation named after her mother.

Rashi Mehta co-founded Rahi Systems in 2013, literally starting in her Fremont garage. It grew to operate in over 25 countries before being acquired by Wesco, a Fortune 200 company, after 12 years. In 2024, she founded the Iron Lady Foundation, named for her mother Dr. Leela Mehta - one of Rajasthan's first practicing gynecologists, who gave free checkups to village women decades ago. The self-funded foundation now runs water systems, science labs and girls' school sponsorships across rural Rajasthan.

One generation gave free checkups in a village with no doctors. The next is funding the schools, water and healthcare that village still needed.

Sources: TriCity Voice, Iron Lady Foundation (2023-2026)
